Traveling with your Apple devices usually means packing a bunch of cables and chargers. The RORRY Flow power bank aims to solve this problem by cramming everything you need into one compact battery. It has a built-in wall plug, an integrated USB-C cable, and a magnetic charger for your Apple Watch. It's exactly the kind of accessory I love using when I travel, handling everything from on-the-go charging to overnight top-ups.

MagSafe Monday: Every Monday, Bradley Chambers rounds up the latest and greatest MagSafe and wireless charging products to help you get the most out of your wireless-charging-capable Apple devices.

Born for travel

This RORRY Flow power bank has foldable wall prongs built into the back, so you don't need to bring an extra brick to charge the battery. Just plug it straight into a hotel or beach house outlet and you're good to go. It also comes with a built-in USB-C cable (I love this feature!), so you don't even need to bring a cable to charge your iPhone, iPad, Kindle, Switch, and more.

Although I usually focus on iPhone MagSafe gear, this power bank specifically has a built-in 5W magnetic charger dedicated to the Apple Watch. Just place your Apple Watch on it to top it up—super convenient. It holds the watch securely in place while charging, so you can leave the stock charger at home.

With a 10,000 mAh capacity, this battery is more than enough to get you through a full day of travel, keeping both your phone and Apple Watch topped up. For me, the killer feature is its 40W output via USB-C, which can even give your MacBook Air a boost in an emergency (with the lid closed).

RORRY Flow power bank wrap-up

If you want to lighten the load in your travel bag for your Apple gear, the RORRY Flow power bank is a solid pick. It can replace your wall charger, Apple Watch charging cable, and USB-C cable all in one device, and it looks pretty sharp too—slips easily into a handbag or pocket.

You can pick up this RORRY Flow portable charger directly from the RORRY website or on Amazon.
